fewShots.question: Which equipment shows a bearing wear anomaly right now?
fewShots.query:
EquipmentTelemetry
| where event_time > ago(15m) and anomaly_type == "BearingWear"
| summarize anomaly_readings = count(), max_vibration_mm_s = max(vibration_mm_s), max_temperature_c = max(temperature_c), last_seen = max(event_time)
    by tag_id, tag_number, equipment_class_name, installation_name
| order by max_vibration_mm_s desc

fewShots.question: What is the latest reading for each tag?
fewShots.query:
EquipmentTelemetry
| summarize arg_max(event_time, *) by tag_id
| project tag_id, tag_number, installation_name, event_time, operating_state, temperature_c, vibration_mm_s, pressure_bar, motor_current_a, anomaly_type

fewShots.question: Show the vibration trend for tag 26-PM-1001 over the last hour.
fewShots.query:
EquipmentTelemetry
| where tag_number == "26-PM-1001" and event_time > ago(1h)
| summarize avg_vibration_mm_s = avg(vibration_mm_s), max_vibration_mm_s = max(vibration_mm_s) by bin(event_time, 1m)
| order by event_time asc
